defaults.source: This study generic passenger-car development assumptions
defaults.rationale: Explicit development value, not a claimed paper parameter or branded vehicle; validate and vary before scientific use.

parameters.name: lane_width_m
parameters.rationale: Planning width adopted explicitly in each new physical lane.

parameters.name: length_m
parameters.rationale: Same explicit 4 m length for all agents; no branded identity.

parameters.name: cg_to_front_axle_m
parameters.rationale: Symmetric generic geometry; CG equals geometric body center, not rear axle or SUMO front bumper.

parameters.name: mass_kg
parameters.rationale: Assumed mass; neither MAT variable m nor fuel multiplier 1.2 determines mass.

parameters.name: front_cornering_stiffness_N_per_rad
parameters.rationale: Entire front axle linear stiffness, not one tire; limited to small-slip regime in future model.

parameters.name: rear_cornering_stiffness_N_per_rad
parameters.rationale: Entire rear axle linear stiffness, not one tire; limited to small-slip regime in future model.

parameters.name: gravity_mps2
parameters.rationale: Declared engineering approximation.

parameters.name: max_steering_rad
parameters.rationale: 40*pi/180; a physical bound, not an unrestricted high-speed command.

parameters.name: min_accel_mps2
parameters.rationale: Hard development envelope; not evidence of available tire-limited braking in all states.

parameters.name: max_accel_mps2
parameters.rationale: Hard paper envelope, separate from comfort.

parameters.name: dynamics_dt_s
parameters.rationale: Future continuous model integrator dt; not yet implemented.

parameters.name: perception_mode
parameters.rationale: Only exact current observations inside the finite ego-frame region; no non-ideal sensor implementation or experiments.

parameters.name: perception_region
parameters.rationale: -rear_range_m <= relative_x <= front_range_m and abs(relative_y) <= side_range_m; no field-of-view angle or occlusion filter.

parameters.name: sensor_delay_s
parameters.rationale: Measurement timestamp equals each perception update time. Sampling and actuator response remain modeled; no additional sensor delay.

parameters.name: occlusion_enabled
parameters.rationale: Every in-range target is observed even if another vehicle is between ego and target; measurements are exact, with no noise, missed detections or sensor outages.

parameters.name: nominal_reference_spacing_m
parameters.rationale: d_ref; same-lane nominal reference spacing 2*d_ref; dynamic safety can enlarge or abandon.

parameters.name: static_map_enabled
parameters.rationale: Lane drop must be observed locally; global road coordinate cannot be a controller trigger.

parameters.name: communication_enabled
parameters.rationale: No V2V/V2I, global grouping or shared plans.

parameters.name: formation_enabled
parameters.rationale: Stage 0-1 only; no implemented controller or formation claim.

parameters.name: energy_analysis_enabled
parameters.rationale: No energy comparison before dynamics, synchronization and units validation.

parameters.name: candidate_emission_class
parameters.source: SUMO HBEFA3 generic passenger gasoline Euro 4 category
parameters.rationale: Explicit candidate category, not a branded vehicle or calibration to the assumed mass; no energy output used this phase.

parameters.name: legacy_vsp_enabled
parameters.rationale: Legacy formula units and normalization unresolved.
